title: Verify GitHub proposal-pin race semantics
mission: Run a bounded repository-host race canary for the discovery proposal pin contract, record winner and loser receipts, prove collision preservation, and return evidence without queue or global-authority promotion.

information_gain.reason: The landed dedup worker explicitly leaves repository-host create-if-absent race behavior unexecuted.

regression_prevention.reason: A host-level race failure could allow duplicate substantive execution when many identical /wc workers discover the same surplus work.
